name: What should I do immediately if I discover a significant pipe leak?

mainEntity.name: What should I do immediately if I discover a significant pipe leak?

acceptedAnswer.text: If you discover a significant pipe leak, your first step should be to shut off the main water supply to your home to minimize water damage. The main shut-off valve is usually located near your water meter or where the main water line enters your house. Next, contact a professional plumber immediately. While waiting for their arrival, try to contain the water with buckets or towels and turn off any nearby electrical appliances.
acceptedAnswer.description: Immediately shut off your home's main water supply, then contact a professional plumber. Contain the water and turn off nearby electrical appliances.
